The petitioners have filed this petition under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 [corresponding to Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973] seeking quashing of FIR No. 996/2020 dated 08.12.2020, registered at Police Station Ranhola, Outer District, New Delhi, under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, and all proceedings emanating therefrom, on the ground of settlement.
2. Issue notice.
Ms. Manjeet Arya, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, accepts notice on behalf of the State.
Notice be issued to respondent No. 2 by all permissible modes.
3. Respondent No. 2 is directed to remain personally present, either This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 26/03/2026 at 20:48:49 physically or through video conference, on the next date of hearing.

4. List on 18.05.2026.
PRATEEK JALAN, J MARCH 25, 2026 'pv/KA'/
